reasoning_traces.think:
The Jackknife+ method constructs prediction intervals by resampling residuals, ensuring validity under exchangeability without fixed train/test splits. This supports GSE's walk-forward validation strategy. Cross-conformal inference improves statistical efficiency by using all available data, reducing waste from single calibration splits. Covariate shift reweighting adjusts for distributional differences between training and test sets, crucial for handling QB changes or rest patterns. These primitives form a coherent framework for uncertainty quantification under dynamic conditions, enabling robust inference even when data is non-stationary or partially observed.
